trigger_condition: hooks.json parses to null or a non-object (e.g. literal null)
potential_consequence: TypeError on parsed.hooks; warn logged on every start until file is fixed

trigger_condition: resolveCodemieBinary returns an absolute path that itself does not exist (e.g. stale argv[1])
potential_consequence: Stale commands rewritten to another missing path; hooks still broken, rewritten every start

trigger_condition: Two CLI processes start concurrently and both repair hooks.json
guard_snippet: await writeFile(tmp, data); await rename(tmp, hooksFile);
potential_consequence: Non-atomic write can leave truncated hooks.json for a concurrent reader

trigger_condition: Stale command separated by tab or has unquoted node path containing spaces
guard_snippet: const m = /\s/.exec(command.slice(start)); const space = m ? start + m.index : -1;
potential_consequence: Token misparsed; stale codemie prefix not detected or repaired, hooks keep failing
